tut.s.ga-hu.say1: Bitter, simmering rage; personal humiliation. Low and tight, not shouting.
tut.s.ga-hu.say3: Satisfied, faintly amused. The trap is set.
tut.s.ga-hu.say4: Urgent, sharp bark into the darkness; alarmed, but still a commander.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say1: Swaggering challenge to his own men; a grin in the voice.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say2: Scoffing 'hmph', grudging. Sarcastic, then takes the duty.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say3: Cold outrage; a dangerous, low demand.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say4: Triumphant, cocky boast after the raid.
tut.s.gang-yu.say4: Defiant resolve in retreat; unbroken spirit.
tut.s.gwak-ga.say1: Quiet, heavy concern for a dear friend; softened but dignified.
tut.s.gwak-ga.say2: Frail but wry; shallow breath, a faint smile.
tut.s.gwak-ga.say3: Calm last words, almost comforting. Breathy and slow.
tut.s.gwak-ga.say4: Grieving, voice catching. Quiet, not theatrical.
tut.s.gwan-u.say1: Arrogant, mocking roar across the battlefield.
tut.s.gwan-u.say2: Worried, gentle warning to his brother.
tut.s.gwan-u.say3: Cold, quiet threat. Short and heavy.
tut.s.gwan-u.say4: Utterly calm, understated. As if returning from a stroll.
tut.s.no-suk.say2: Polite but firm; reasonable, then steel underneath.
tut.s.ma-cho.say2: Serious, calm warning to his cousin.
tut.s.bang-deok.say4: Quiet respect for a fallen enemy.
tut.s.bang-tong.say1: Slow, brooding, thinking aloud; a ruler weighing a problem.
tut.s.bang-tong.say2: Smooth, flattering persuasion with a hidden smirk.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.say1: Mocking, lightly amused taunt; calm and cutting.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.say4: Quiet awe, then a chilling, ambitious calm.
tut.s.seo-seo.say6: Cold fury, low and demanding; not shouting wildly.
tut.s.son-gwon.say2: Dry, understated loyalty; a hint of rough humor.
tut.s.son-gwon.say4: Slow, grudging admiration, half to himself, with a faint wry smile.
tut.s.sun-uk.say4: Satisfied, quietly pleased; a cold, knowing smile.
tut.s.yeo-mong.say3: Mildly suspicious, then lazy and dismissive.
tut.s.yu-bi.say7: Emotional, impassioned plea; voice rising with feeling.
tut.s.jang-bi.say1: Commanding, imperious order across the battlefield.
tut.s.jang-bi.say3: Casual, warm and confident; friendly bravado.
tut.s.jang-bi.say8: Deeply moved, voice choked with emotion.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say1: Exultant command; the wind has come.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say3: Furious, commanding orders; fierce but in control.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say9: Light, amused aside, almost to himself.
tut.s.jo-un.say1: Gentle, soothing whisper to a child, then firm resolve.
tut.s.jo-un.say3: Quiet appreciation of a fine sword.
tut.s.jo-jo.say1: Unhurried and probing over wine; a sly, controlled smile, testing his guest.
tut.s.jo-jo.say2: Careful, modest answer; hiding his true thoughts.
tut.s.jo-jo.say3: Low, slow and knowing; quietly menacing.
tut.s.ju-yu.say8: Wry, pained humor with a chuckle.
tut.s.heo-jeo.say4: Heavy relief and gratitude, low and sincere.
